slide1.headline: Breaking News: SpaceX Acquires AI Coding Startup Cursor
slide1.subtitle: A major move in the AI industry

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: SpaceX acquired AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion.
This acquisition comes just days after SpaceX's Nasdaq debut.
The deal is an all-stock transaction.
Cursor's valuation is now at $60 billion.

lines: This acquisition highlights the growing importance of AI in the tech industry.
SpaceX's move into AI coding startup acquisition may indicate a shift in its business strategy.
The deal may also have implications for the future of AI development and innovation.

bullets: The acquisition may lead to increased collaboration between SpaceX and Cursor.
The deal's valuation may have a significant impact on the AI industry as a whole.
